_comment: Инструменты агента во время звонка (формат function calling: OpenAI Realtime, Retell, ElevenLabs). Каждый вызов уходит обработчику портала, тот пишет в Битрикс (алгоритм звонилки, п. 6). rfq_no — из списка запросов звонка.

tools.name: resend_rfq
tools.description: Re-send our request for quotation email to the supplier, optionally to a corrected address. Call it as soon as the supplier says they did not receive the email and confirms the address.

rfq_no.description: RFQ number from the list of requests on this call

email.description: Confirmed email address to send to; empty if the original address is correct

tools.name: remind_email
tools.description: Send a short reminder email about the request(s). Use after leaving a voicemail.

rfq_no.description: RFQ number, or 'all' for every request on this call

tools.name: add_contact
tools.description: Save the person who handles quotations at the supplier.

tools.name: set_quote_date
tools.description: Record the date by which the supplier promised to send the quotation.

tools.name: mark_declined
tools.description: The supplier cannot quote this request.

reason.description: Reason in the supplier's words, e.g. not our product, discontinued, cannot export

alternative_supplier.description: Who could supply it, if the supplier said

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Pass a question the agent must not answer (price, technical, terms, project, end use) or a special situation to the responsible sourcing manager. The manager answers by email the same day.

question.description: The supplier's question or the situation, in English

tools.name: do_not_call
tools.description: The supplier asked not to be called again. Future contact by email only.
